Team —

Following a productive demo with Neurolytics last week, they want to move forward with ACE registration and would like PDM/PSM introductions so we can align on co-sell readiness and a kickoff. I attached a short opportunity brief and a draft ACE spreadsheet with some high-level IDs.

Asks:
- Vanessa: can you lead the PDM intro (technical readiness, evidence scope)?
- Karthik: can you cover the PSM/workflow ownership and field enablement?
- Soojin: please add any marketplace listing blockers you know of (pricing SKU, entitlements).

- Tue Dec 5, 10am PT or Wed Dec 6, 9am PT

External context: Neurolytics (medical imaging SaaS) cares about data residency and SOC2 evidence; their procurement team has a tight timeline for Q1 pilots. I will loop in Emma from their side once we have internal alignment.

Attachments: Neurolytics-Opportunity-Brief.pdf, ACE-Registration-Draft.xlsx

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + ACE registration for Neurolytics — quick coordination

Thanks Marcus — looping Emma in.

Emma — great to meet you by email. For PDM prep, I generally ask for the following (I put a short checklist below). If you can drop any of these into the Drive link Marcus shared, we can validate quickly ahead of the kickoff.

PDM evidence checklist (high level):
- SOC2 report (latest) or attestation
- Data flow diagram (how imaging data moves, where it's stored)
- Encryption at rest/transit statements and KMS pattern
- Intended AWS regions and VPC/network architecture
- Any third-party subprocessors (names + roles)

Marketplace listing / SKU notes (from ops):
- We typically map to 2 SKUs at launch: paid subscription (monthly) and pilot/consulting seat. I will follow up with pricing conventions and a short SKU worksheet.

Proposed mutual action plan for the next 2 weeks:
1) Internal handoff (Redwood): confirm PDM/PSM owners — assigned (Vanessa / Karthik) — complete by Dec 1
2) External kickoff with Neurolytics + ACE: Dec 5, 10am PT — proposed agenda: intro, evidence checklist, timeline, next steps
3) Submit ACE registration materials to AWS portal: target Dec 6-8 pending evidence
4) Marketplace listing prep: draft SKUs & pricing by Dec 8

I will attach a sample SKU worksheet momentarily. Marcus — can you confirm Dec 5/10am PT and that you will invite the ACE contact (ace@amazon.com)?

Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Product Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
